title: autopilot.json
description: What the guard is allowed to let an automated author change in this repository.

agentAuthor.description: Login of the agent whose commits the guard constrains, e.g. `my-bot[bot]`.

botAuthor.description: Login of the dependency bot. Its commits may touch **only** manifests and workflow files -- anything else is a violation -- and it is not asked to prove its tests.

maxLines.description: Cap on the agent's total changed lines.

forbidden.description: Extra globs the agent may never touch. `.github/**` and package manifests are always forbidden.

apps.description: The parts of the repository the guard knows how to test.

path.description: Directory, relative to the repository root. Empty or "." is the root itself, for a single-package repository.

run.description: Argv that runs the named test files, e.g. ["npx", "vitest", "run"]. Paths are appended, relative to `path`.

tests.description: Globs, relative to `path`, matching everything the guard treats as a test.

unitTests.description: Globs, relative to `path`, for the tests cheap enough to re-run at the base commit.
